title: From Hamilton : Rotorua Wai-O-Tapu and Te Puia with Haka
blurb:
Explore the geothermal wonders of Rotorua on this guided tour from Hamilton. Visit the vibrant landscapes of Wai-O-Tapu, famous for its colorful geothermal features, before experiencing the mighty Pōhutu Geyser at Te Puia. Engage with Māori culture through a captivating haka performance and learn about their traditions during a guided walk. This full-day adventure combines natural beauty with rich cultural insights, making it perfect for travelers interested in New Zealand's unique heritage.

- Full-day small group tour from Hamilton (max 16 passengers)
- Explore Wai-O-Tapu's geothermal landscapes and bubbling mud pools
- Witness the Pōhutu Geyser eruption and enjoy a traditional Māori haka
- Snacks and water provided; lunch available for purchase during the tour
